description_en: Invoke this API to query the details of a sound code schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询声码排程详情
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-sound-code-schedule --schedule-code Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot-v6400000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSoundCodeSchedule

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the **ID** does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
